data.name: 6-7 In-A-Row
data.detailed_description:
6-7 In-A-Row is a fast, competitive strategy board game for 2–4 players that mixes the instant clarity of Tic-Tac-Toe with the “one more round” tension of Connect-4 style games—without gravity.

Place your token anywhere on the board. No dropping, no sliding, no excuses. Build lines, block threats, set traps, and try to be the first to connect at least 6 in a row (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal).

And yes… winning with 6 is a win... technically.
The game will acknowledge it accordingly.

Key Features:

  • Win condition with attitude: Connect 6+ in a row to win. The longer your line, the better the bragging rights (and the less judgment you’ll receive).

  • 2–4 players: Play head-to-head or bring the chaos with 3–4 colors.

  • Local + Online (Friends): Pass-and-play locally or challenge friends online in a private lobby. (Matchmaking may come later.)

  • Bots with 3 difficulties: Practice against Easy / Medium / Hard AI—good luck blaming lag.

  • 3D with a 2D feel: A clean tabletop presentation built for readability, with zoom + slight pan + reset camera controls.

  • Humor system: Randomized humorous win/lose/tie phrases, including custom lines depending on whether you won with 6, 7, or more.

  • Online per-turn timers (optional): Keep matches moving when things get serious.

Simple rules. Real strategy. Friendly roasting.

data.short_description: A modern tabletop-style strategy game for 2–4 players. Local or online with friends, bots from Easy to Hard, and hilarious win/lose lines based on how hard you actually won. Place tokens anywhere on the board and line up 6+ in a row to win. Winning with 6 counts… technically.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i3 / AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11-capable (1–2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX11/DX12-capable (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
